nameOrigin: a mammal in the weasel family

pokedexEntries.go: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.

pokedexEntries.si: There is no telling where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

pokedexEntries.cr: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more mazelike they become.

pokedexEntries.rs: FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this POKéMON is very nimble and fleet.

pokedexEntries.fr: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

pokedexEntries.dpp: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
